name: Square
description: Access Square’s commerce platform to view transaction data, manage customer profiles, track inventory, process payments, and analyze sales patterns. Handle point-of-sale operations, generate financial reports, and manage business operations through Claude’s natural language interface for streamlined commerce management.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Square to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Square to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.squareup.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Square MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Square provides these MCP tools: get_service_info, get_type_info, and make_api_request.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Square?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Square in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Square requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Square is developed by Square, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
